messages:
dylan: proposal: add 'tracelets' to onboarding. tiny deterministic traces to exercise tokenization, kv-cache, and attention edgecases. cheap and fast.
riya: how are these different from golden samples + mini-bench?
kevin: golden checks semantics, mini-bench measures perf. tracelets are unit-like sequences for runtime invariants (token alignment, kv rotation, small latency).
sarah: useful to catch kv-cache evictions and off-by-one tokenization.
dylan: run at admit, on canary, and during runtime/kernel upgrades. isolates runtime vs weights.
matt: manifest change? models ship optional tracelets?
kevin: yes, manifest adds small list. requires verified|unverified flag. unverified runs only in isolated smokehouse.
riya: limit asserts to structural and numeric checks, avoid full-text equality.
matt: store compact summaries in registry for console diffs; keep full logs 7d.
dylan: mitigation for flakiness: re-run threshold default n=3 before alerting.
sarah: fallback: if verified tracelet fails on canary, auto-fallback to previous runtime variant.
dylan: i'll draft RFC follow-up with schema, run semantics, and storage rules. bench-bot, post results here.
